notes.title: 📓 Nita's Diary Update ✒️
notes.notes:
Hello Juventurers,

this is a really BIG update, are you ready? I hope WE are ːsteamhappyː

We have an all new scene for you to seek out: Nita's Room 🚪
Not only has it a lot to find, there is also a nice souvenir shelf where Nita puts all the amazing things she finds, so you might want to come back here from time to time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31524592/458d8bd6982308b8dc24f0fdd72b9ff62644b74e.png[/img]

Ah the Diary, a feature planned for so long that the ticket number has 2 digits (#82), we are currently on ticket [strike]#181[/strike] #184.
All the weird, magical and wondrous things Nita finds are written down here with detailed descriptions, drawings and schematics. You can look up a lot of things that are hard to find when you just do not know what they actually are, like Actias Luna, Kakapo and the Beear.
It is [b]FAR FROM COMPLETION[/b] but it has a lot of the essential entries and will be updated over time.

[b]Update Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Nita's Diary 📓
[*] New Scene: Nita's Room 🚪
[*] World Map 🗺️
[*] Interactive Tutorial ℹ️🐍
[*] Bug Fixes 🐛
[*] Improvements 🛠️
[/list]

Enjoy one of our biggest and most important updates :ghsmile:

- JujiBla

notes.title: Late Easter Update 🐇
notes.notes:
We know we are "a bit late" but have fun with our little Easter update, that fixes our broken [url=https://www.redbubble.com/de/people/jujibla/shop]Redbubble[/url] links and adds more new beautiful hand drawn decoration to the main menu.
There are also a few pictures that can be bought on [url=https://displate.com/jujibla/displates/all]Displate[/url] now :ghsmile:

have fun and stay safe everyone 💖 #StayHome

- the SpielmannSpiel Team

notes.title: Update 0.9.0 - Rock Shelter
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524592/7bddcc46deebc76ce9c5569443dcb5d1ac2c5d99.png[/img]

Hello juventurers,

we are proud to reveal the newest scene Rock Shelter to you, the players.
As the project moves on, we’ve finally started polishing. There are a lot of performance tweaks (especially to reduce the long loading times) and long wished features as well. One of the biggest issues you had became the newest feature:
the Sound Settings will now be saved.
YES, that’s right, this amazing, revolutionary feature is now available for all of you!
And as always, we hope you enjoy this new release ːghsmileː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524592/dea3dac61aeb9622ee80935a38571ac37007062a.jpg[/img]

Oh, by the way: you can now play the very first available version of JuVentures from steam, on steam.
The “historical” branch has been released to the public.
Just go to the GAME SETTINGS (right click), select the BETA tab and switch to the “historical” branch.
WARNING: playing this old version  will definitely reset your savegame and remove your progress and settings.

And here is a quite incomplete changelog, with the (hopefully) interesting parts for you.
[list]
[*] v0.9.0 - Steam Update
[*] Rock Shelter #123
[*] fixing deprecated warning
[*] top menu: new prefabs for signs #132
[*] optimize Left-Click movement #135
[*] fixes zoom stutter
[*] finger zoom controls #138
[*] optimize ingame settings #137
[*] optimize camera access #136
[*] left-click movement #135
[*] re-order found items in top menu #105
[*] flux on marsh still visible #118
[*] settings: Save Volume #109
[*] optimize menu #121
[*] rearrange menu stuff #122
[*] optimize sprites: start menu
[/list]

- JujiBla

notes.title: Update v0.4.9 - BUGTALES
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524592/e6cdd622e7c71530dbedcabbf6acd25d764a3d50.png[/img]

Space: the final frontier. These are the voyages of a hidden objects game...

No, that’s not a feature, it was a game-breaking bug and I am really really sorry for that.
I usually test 2-3 scenes after every release, so I got the wrong ones this time. Some scenes had this bug that made it impossible to play, finish or even leave the game. Thanks to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/theferalelite]FeRaL[/url]  who streamed and recorded it, so I was able to fix it “quickly” (this bug was there for around 3 days).

I apologize to all players and hope you can still enjoy our little game. 

- bison

notes.title: Update v0.4.1 - Patch Runner
notes.notes:
Hello juventurers,

These past few days have been really busy, fixing all the hidden bugs you have found and enjoying you enjoying our game. Thank you very much 💖
Since we patched instantly and didn’t want to spam you with tiny change logs, this is a collection of everything we put into JuVentures since the launch at 5.1.2018.
There is still a lot to do, and we will keep updating instantly to bring you the best game experience as soon as possible, so there will be from time to time a patch-rundown like this one when we finish a milestone.
Just that you don’t wonder if nothing is going on. Players will see the current version number in game.

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524592/6d878f8b2ed67f831ac36388aa6d871712733e52.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524592/f7bdb9c7928a132b63aeaadef7945aef46d80b36.png[/img][/url]

All changes from youngest to oldest:

[list]
[*]v0.4.1 - steam update
[*]clicking on the pictures starts the level
[*]fix: prevent coffee from drifting into space
[*]settings from within the game
[*]v0.4.0
[*]fix: UI arrows
[*]fix: compass start flicker
[*]optimizing compass zoom on dune

[/list]

- JujiBla
